en: The image shows a colored photograph of a pier complex on a bay, with large industrial buildings marked 'PIER 6' and ships docked alongside. The water is calm and there is a small boat in the foreground. The sky is mostly clear with a few clouds. Text in both Spanish and English is printed on the image, describing the location as the Atlantic Terminal and Cristobal Piers from the bay, at the Panama Canal.
